title: Mixed Event — This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day — Episode8 Spectacular Caretakers!

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day
meta.Event Outline: Fresh second-years Minori and Shiho are on the animal caretaker committee, and their work has already begun. When they learn about a shadowing opportunity at Odaiba Animal Land from a teacher, they decide to participate. Animal antics ensue!

rows.Line: A few days later - Before classes
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out, Minori.
There's a news article online about you and the others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Minori Hanasato and Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP! teamed up to capture an escaped armadillo...”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
“...and all the guests applauded when they succeeded.”
That's pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To be fair, Shiho was the one who caught Dylan, not us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They embellished the story a little... But I guess they didn't write anything negative.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and I heard that your shadowing went very well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii had such a wonderful expression on her face while she told me about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad it was fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It really was! And after it ended, we even went around with Haruka and Ichika to all the places that we missed during our break!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Including the petting zoo...
Shiho looked so happy while playing with all the cute little animals.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She also looked really sad when it became time for us to leave.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She really fell in love with that baby lop-eared rabbit...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Shiho and Haruka couldn't stop talking about penguins after that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, she also really likes them.
We even made plans to go to the Penguin Cafe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It's great that you two got to chat over a shared interest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You got to help take care of the animals and see the entire zoo... That certainly sounds like a full day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
Luka came to visit during all that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, she did?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. She told me where to go and stuff while we were trying to catch Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<There wasn't much you could do.
I mean, I wasn't expecting him to jump like that.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No fair, Luka.
I wish I could've seen Dylan.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Me too!
You could've told us where you were going!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Luka...! Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hello, Minori.
I decided to drop by again♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I should've gone with you last time.
I probably would've gotten to see all those animals...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry, Rin.
I was worried that us all going together would cause Minori and the others too much trouble.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't all of us go together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <All of us?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I really want to go now after hearing about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Really?!
Let's go! Right this second!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Right now may be a bit difficult...
But I'd also like to go.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They have a wide variety of animals, large and small, yes? I'm interested in seeing the frogs since I heard that some are supposed to have pretty patterns!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Frogs...?
I think I'll pass...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you're all aching to go. In terms of when, how about—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there's the bell.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait, we have that assembly today!
We gotta get over to the gym!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What?! You're going?!
But we still haven't decided when we're all going to the zoo!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Rin, you should ask so much of them.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The zoo's not going anywhere, so we can talk about it again later.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Then, we'll talk again in SEKAI.
For now, have a nice day!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, see you guys later!
Gym

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: ...and that's why I took this opportunity today to tell you about a writer who calls this school her alma mater. I hope you all get a chance to read her works.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Mhm...
The principal's stories always make me feel so sleepy for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know they're supposed to be educational, but I just can't process anything...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Next, we have commendations.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: This time is usually for clubs and committees that have made significant accomplishments.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: But today, the school has received a letter of appreciation, which I would like to read out.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Shiho Hinomori from Class 2-B.
Minori Hanasato from Class 2-D.
Please come up to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Class 2...Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-What?! Me?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Is this about the zoo?
For now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess I should go up.)
se_walk_women_005_3
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Ahem. We've received a formal letter of appreciation from Odaiba Animal Land where you both shadowed...

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: “When working with our caretakers, not only did your students perform their duties magnificently...”

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: “They also connected with the animals, showed a deep compassion for them and even kept our zoo safe.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We kept it safe...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm guessing they're referring to us catching Dylan.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line:
“On behalf of the zoo, I would like to take this opportunity to recognize your students' efforts and achievements. From the bottom of my heart, thank you.”
Your work has not gone unnoticed, it would seem.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting this to happen...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me neither... But I'm glad we were able to help. Plus, I got to become friends with Schubert.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you had a lot of fun while feeding the chipmunks, Shiho! The face you made was so cute! Let's keep doing our best as members of the animal caretaker committee!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Talk about a hot mic...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Did everyone just hear that...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You didn't need to tell them about the chipmunks!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm really sorry, Shiho!
